name: Moda - Slides & Designs
original_description: Moda gives ChatGPT a real design canvas for creating, editing, reviewing, organizing, sharing, and exporting fully editable presentations, sales collateral, social creative, print assets, and generated media. It preserves editable text and layers, supports brand kits and team templates, and exports finished work to formats including PowerPoint, PDF, PNG, and video.
